subject: Burst capacity sponsorship & launch runbook
messages:
From: Emma Sawyer <emma@pixlhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Upcoming product launch — short-term burst capacity request

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — PixlHealth is targeting a soft-launch for our patient triage feature the week of 2026-12-20. We ran a quick internal projection and attached an updated traffic sheet (pixlhealth-traffic-projection-v3.xlsx).

Two quick asks so we can finalize our launch checklist:
- Can Redwood provide a temporary increase to our token/concurrency ceiling for a 72-hour launch window? We expect peak QPS to be ~4–6x our current trial traffic.
- What telemetry or ramp controls do you require from our side to approve a burst exception?

We’re happy to coordinate a short runbook and share logs during the window. Ryan (cc’d) is our engineering lead and will own ramp coordination.

Appreciate any guidance on process and timing — we need internal sign-off by next Wednesday (2026-12-08).

Best,
Emma Sawyer
Head of Product Operations | PixlHealth
emma@pixlhealth.com

Attachments: pixlhealth-traffic-projection-v3.xlsx
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Sawyer <emma@pixlhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming product launch — short-term burst capacity request

Thanks Emma — digging into your projection now (looks clear and well structured). A few things from our side to get this moving:

1) Temporary exception scope: please confirm the desired window (start/end timestamps) and the target multiplier vs baseline (you mentioned 4–6x; is 5x a safe single target?).
2) Ramp plan: a brief staged ramp (0% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 6 hours) with telemetry checkpoints is ideal. Can Ryan confirm this cadence?
3) Telemetry & guardrails we need from you:
   - Token-level sampling for first-page responses (one-minute granularity)
   - Error budget alerting (5% increased error rate triggers immediate rollback)
   - Contact for on-call during window (name + phone)

Marissa / Karthik — tagging you for product/ops approval and any routing or model-variant constraints. Specifically: is a 72-hour / single-window burst at 5x within policy if Pixl provides the ramp plan and telemetry? If not, what gating would you require (e.g., staged canary across regions, model downgrade path)?

Emma — once product confirms, I can draft a short runbook and central DocuSign for sign-off. We can also map this to HubSpot deal PX-2026-117.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Emma Sawyer <emma@pixlhealth.com>, Ryan Patel <ryan@pixlhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming product launch — short-term burst capacity request

Connor / Emma / Ryan —

Thanks for the clear ask and projection. Quick internal assessment: we can support a controlled burst but with the following conditions to protect other tenants and meet SLOs. Proposed approval terms (conditional):

- Window: 2026-12-20T00:00Z -> 2026-12-22T00:00Z (72 hours). Please confirm local timezone mapping.
- Cap: temporary 5x token ceiling with a soft concurrency cap of 8 concurrent requests per customer during the first 12 hours; after successful steady-state we can relax to the full 5x token ceiling.
- Routing: traffic must route to the designated dedicated pool (dedicated-px-1); if Pixl requires hosted fallback, it must be flagged in the runbook.
- Telemetry required from Pixl: 1-min token/success/error sampling, request traces for any 5xx, and a Slack alert channel for the on-call alias.
- Canary/ramp: staged ramp as outlined by Connor (0/30/60/100) with 30-minute hold at each stage for checks.

Operational asks from our side: Pixl fills the attached burst_approval_form.pdf with start/end timestamps, contact details, and agrees to share the live telemetry dashboard link. We will provision the temporary limits 48 hours before start.

If Pixl signs the form and confirms the runbook, I can approve the temporary limits and notify infrastructure to reserve capacity. Note: this approval assumes no overlapping launches from other customers at the same pool — if that changes we’ll need to re-evaluate.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Product Manager, Hosting & Capacity
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: burst_approval_form.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Sawyer <emma@pixlhealth.com>, Ryan Patel <ryan@pixlhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Final runbook & next steps — PixlHealth launch (action required)

Emma / Ryan — thanks for moving quickly. Per Marissa’s approval, summary and immediate asks:

Summary
- Approved window: 2026-12-20 00:00Z -> 2026-12-22 00:00Z
- Temporary cap: 5x token ceiling; initial 12-hour soft concurrency cap at 8, then relax if telemetry is green
- Required deliverables from Pixl: completed burst_approval_form.pdf, one-minute telemetry link, on-call contact

Immediate asks (before 2026-12-18 17:00 PT)
1) Ryan — confirm ramp script and sign-off on staged cadence (0/30/60/100 over 6 hours).
2) Emma — complete and return the attached burst_approval_form.pdf and sign the DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef123456
3) Provide HubSpot deal confirmation (I’ll attach the runbook to PX-2026-117 once signed).

Post-approval ops
- We’ll provision limits 48 hours prior and schedule a smoke test at T-24h with Marissa and infra on-call.
- If any 5xx spike > 5% or latency degradation > 40% vs baseline, we’ll execute immediate rollback to the pre-launch profile.

I’ve attached the runbook draft in HubSpot and added the DocuSign; once you sign we’ll route to infra for provisioning.

Cheers,
Connor
Connor O'Brien | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
